svg.title: Mind, World, Pulse, Private
svg.desc: Four parts of W.E.D.N.E.S.D.A.Y.: Mind, the assistant on a local model; World, the living Earth in Live, Time and Orbit modes; Pulse, a briefing of significant records with source and time; and Private, a core that listens only to 127.0.0.1. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
